messages:
Support_Ryan: Customer (org: acme-corp) reporting repeated 504/502s over the last hour, lots of timeouts. They say requests spike and then gateway returns 504s.
Alice_ops: Seen similar across a couple tenants. Symptoms: long queue depth on gateway, backend pods show long starting times but become Ready quickly.
Jordan_eng: Can you paste the error snippets and a sample request id?
Support_Ryan: req_id=rcv-8f3c. Gateway logs: `upstream timed out after 30s` then `502 Bad Gateway` when the pool is saturated. Customer says latency goes from <200ms to 30s then 504.
Nina_sre: Just pulled cluster metrics — HPA for inference-deploy has stable replicas=1 despite surge, KEDAScaledObject metrics show no trigger. KEDA logs show occasional 202 from /metrics probe.
k8s-bot: Event: ScaledObject acme-model-scaleobj - No metrics detected for 300s, cooldown active.
Alice_ops: That 202 is suspicious — our metrics exporter sometimes returns 202 when auth token to billing/usage service fails and exporter short-circuits. If metrics exporter returns 2xx non-200 we drop the metric.
Jordan_eng: So HPA/KEDA not seeing the real traffic because exporter occasionally short-circuits -> no scale up -> requests pile up -> gateway times out. Makes sense.
Support_Ryan: Customer provided repro steps: send continuous 20 RPS with ~1.5s generation per token, after 2 mins the gateway 504s start. Attaching sample log block.
Support_Ryan: ```
[2026-03-17T14:08:12Z] pod/inference-0 ready
[2026-03-17T14:08:15Z] exporter: metric-post failed: 403 billing-service
[2026-03-17T14:09:00Z] gateway: queued=120 active=1
[2026-03-17T14:09:42Z] gateway: upstream timeout 30s req=rcv-8f3c
```
Nina_sre: Also seeing warmup: container enters Ready but model shard download continues in background (model init logs show progress). Readiness probe uses simple /health HTTP which returns 200 early. So pods are counted but not actually warm.
Alice_ops: Combined failure mode: (1) exporter returning non-200 suppresses KEDA metrics -> no scale up, (2) readiness probe returns early -> pod counted as ready while cold -> queue backlog -> gateway timeouts.
Jordan_eng: Proposed mitigations: change readiness probe to check model-ready endpoint; make metrics exporter return explicit 200+metric payload even if billing auth fails (fallback to last-known); increase KEDA tolerance (short-term) and set targetCPU/requests so HPA can act when metrics absent.
Support_Ryan: Customer asks for immediate mitigation. They want quick rollback or config change.
Nina_sre: Short term: 1) Patch readiness probe to /model/v1/ready (non-default) on affected deploys. 2) Temporarily lower KEDA cooldown to 30s for that scaledobject and add a fallback HPA minReplicas=2. 3) Roll a small change to exporter to never return 202 on auth error, instead return 200 with zero metric.
Alice_ops: I can push a quick helm patch for the readiness and KEDA cooldown to the staging cluster and test with synthetic traffic.
Jordan_eng: I'll open PR to change exporter behavior and backport to current image tag.
Support_Ryan: Noted. I'll coordinate with customer to throttle traffic and test once we roll changes.
k8s-bot: Deployments updated: inference-deploy v2.1.3 -> rolled to staging (patch-ready-probe). Monitor for 15m.
Alice_ops: After patching staging, generated 25 RPS for 10m — no 504s, pods scaled to 3 and model-ready logs showed complete before traffic hit.
Support_Ryan: Customer confirmed partial recovery after we applied the staging patch to production: 504s dropped from 12/min to 0-1/min. They want root cause writeup and follow-ups.
Jordan_eng: Action items: 1) prod rollout of readiness + KEDA cooldown patch (owner: Alice_ops). 2) Exporter fix PR + deploy (owner: Jordan_eng). 3) Add canary test for metrics exporter auth failure (owner: Nina_sre). 4) Postmortem with timeline and customer impact (owner: Support_Ryan).
Support_Ryan: I'll open the incident ticket and loop in account team + CSM for comms. :white_check_mark:
summary: Autoscaling failure caused by metrics exporter auth fallback (202) + early readiness probe leading to pods counted as ready while model still initializing; resulted in gateway queueing and 504/502s. Short-term patches applied and recovery observed. Actions planned: readiness probe fix, exporter behavior change, KEDA config adjustments, postmortem and customer comms.
